zN3HQI8J2cvKJGYqBt4YGQ.zh: 泊爾今年截至10月初累計報告9,923例確定病例,其中7例死亡,疫情自7月起快速上升,其中9月新增2,746例(占全年病例數近三成),病患分布於74個行政區。當局已加強宣導農業與戶外活動⺠眾穿著⻑袖衣褲並使用防蚊劑,且提供免費抗生素治療。另該國於2024-25年流行季累計報告1.6萬例病例。
zN3HQI8J2cvKJGYqBt4YGQ.en: Nepal has reported 9,923 confirmed cases this year as of early October, including 7 deaths. Cases have risen rapidly since July, with 2,746 new cases in September alone, nearly 30% of the year's total, distributed across 74 districts. Authorities have stepped up messaging urging people working in agriculture and outdoor activities to wear long-sleeved clothing and use insect repellent, and provide free antibiotic treatment. The country also reported 16,000 cases in the 2024–25 epidemic season.

ua3I0YsyPZq0ug3w3Cf1qg.zh: 泊爾拉蘇瓦(Rasuwa)地區於8/26爆發災難性山洪,已有數千人罹難及失蹤,努瓦科縣(Nuwakot)避難中亦已報告腹瀉與發燒病例,且有5處飲用水源遭大腸桿菌汙染。當局警告受汙染之飲用水極易導致霍亂、傷寒及A型/E型肝炎等腸道傳染病疫情,預計替10 萬名⺠眾接種霍亂疫苗、7.5萬名兒童接種麻疹及德國麻疹疫苗。WHO亦已緊急提供登革熱、瘧疾、恙蟲病、流感及鉤端螺旋體病等快篩試劑,以加強疫情監測。
ua3I0YsyPZq0ug3w3Cf1qg.en: A catastrophic flash flood struck the Rasuwa area of Nepal on 26 August; thousands of people have died or gone missing. In evacuation shelters in Nuwakot district, cases of diarrhoea and fever have also been reported, and five drinking water sources have been contaminated with E. coli. Authorities warn that contaminated drinking water can readily cause outbreaks of intestinal infections such as cholera, typhoid and hepatitis A and E. They plan to vaccinate 100,000 people against cholera and 75,000 children against measles and rubella. WHO has also urgently provided rapid test kits for dengue, malaria, scrub typhus, influenza and leptospirosis to strengthen outbreak surveillance.

ZApDBy4N5VDHBWJzRkAfGA.zh: 泊爾疫情上升,今年截至8/11累計46例確定病例,其中9例死亡(CFR:20%),疫情逐漸向東部特萊平原(Terai)蔓延,相較2025年,以藍毗省最為嚴重。該國疫情流行高峰介於6-10月,惟當局針對高風險區之疫苗接種計畫要到2027年才能展開,預期疫情將持續上升。該國去年累計141例感染,41例死亡(CFR :23%),76%死亡病例年齡大於40歲 ,顯示該疾病正在影響大量超出常規兒童疫苗接種年齡範圍的族群。 印度阿薩姆州(Assam)疫情持續,今年7月報告156例確定病例,其中至少20例死亡(CFR: 12.8%)。自2018年迄今,該州占全國死亡總數達6成。當局已於高風險地區推動疫苗接種(涵蓋率約75%),惟該邦近期面臨洪災,加上正水稻種植及雨季,恐加劇病媒蚊孳生,預期疫情將持續至季風季節結束。
ZApDBy4N5VDHBWJzRkAfGA.en: Nepal's epidemic is rising: as of 11 August this year, 46 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 9 deaths (CFR 20%). The outbreak is gradually spreading into the eastern Terai plains, and compared with 2025, Lumbini Province is the most severely affected. The epidemic peak in the country falls between June and October, but the vaccination programme for high-risk areas will not begin until 2027, so cases are expected to keep rising. Last year the country cumulatively recorded 141 infections and 41 deaths (CFR 23%), with 76% of deaths in people over 40, indicating that the disease is affecting many people beyond the age range covered by routine childhood vaccination. In Assam state, India, the outbreak continues: 156 confirmed cases were reported in July this year, of which at least 20 died (CFR 12.8%). Since 2018, the state has accounted for 60% of national deaths. Authorities have promoted vaccination in high-risk areas (coverage about 75%), but the state has recently been hit by flooding, and paddy cultivation and the rainy season may intensify mosquito breeding; the outbreak is expected to continue until the end of the monsoon season.

1BlGexCO1199WOmqkA63fw.zh: 疫情更新:  人類疫情:今年累計報告H5N1流感5例、H9N2流感12例及H10N3流感1例,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計56國家/地區報告3,303起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。 共15國於2026/3/11-4/30期間報告439起H5N1疫情,德國361起、智利18起、南韓14起、波蘭13起、泊爾7起、法國5起、美國/臺灣各4起、加拿大3起、丹麥/奧地利/挪威/荷蘭各2起、柬埔寨/義大利各1起。 南韓於2026/4/29報告4起H5N9疫情。 美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計20州報告1,093起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州/威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/4/19-25共425個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/馬里蘭/麻薩諸塞州共11個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
1BlGexCO1199WOmqkA63fw.en: Update. Human cases: this year, 5 H5N1, 12 H9N2 and 1 H10N3 human influenza cases have been reported cumulatively. Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 56 countries and territories have reported 3,303 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks this year. Fifteen countries reported 439 H5N1 outbreaks between 11 March and 30 April 2026: Germany 361, Chile 18, South Korea 14, Poland 13, Nepal 7, France 5, the United States and Taiwan four each, Canada 3, Denmark, Austria, Norway and the Netherlands two each, and Cambodia and Italy one each. South Korea reported four H5N9 outbreaks on 29 April 2026. US dairy cattle avian influenza has accounted for 1,093 outbreaks reported across 20 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Idaho, Wisconsin and California. US wastewater monitoring provided results for 425 sampling sites during 19–25 April 2026, of which 11 sites in New Jersey, Illinois, Maryland and Massachusetts detected H5-positive results.

nJ1g_tlcYp9US8OjvWQr_w.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至去(2025)年12/31累計143國/地區報告17萬7千餘例確診病例,其中,至少477例死亡;去年累計99國/地區報告5萬餘例確診病例,其中215例死亡。WHO 去年12月共計42國家/地區報告1,169 例新增確診病例,其中 6例死亡,69%來自非洲地區,相較11月,全球各區疫情皆呈下降趨勢,捷克、以色列、馬達加斯加、泊爾及法屬馬約特島通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2025/12/7-2026/1/18)共計15 國通報871例確診病例,5例死亡,其中,以剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、馬達加斯加、賴比瑞亞、肯亞及迦納為高。馬達加斯加自去年12月起爆發Ib型社區傳播,首例為近期無旅遊史個案,已迅速擴散至全國。 非洲以外地區,法國、義大利及西班牙持續出現Ib型社區傳播;捷克通報1例病例仍在調查中。 WHO發布《Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus》,彙整現有證據與專家意見,說明執行 MPXV 基因體監測的之關鍵考量,以支持病原體基因體學於公共衛生監測及應變之應用。WHO 1/22
nJ1g_tlcYp9US8OjvWQr_w.en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 31 December 2025, 143 countries and areas have reported more than 177,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 477 deaths. In 2025, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 215 deaths (WHO). In December 2025, 42 countries and areas reported 1,169 new confirmed cases, including 6 deaths; 69% came from the African Region. Compared with November, cases declined in all regions. Czechia, Israel, Madagascar, Nepal and Mayotte (France) reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the six weeks from 7 December 2025 to 18 January 2026, 15 countries reported 871 confirmed cases and 5 deaths, with the highest numbers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia, Kenya and Ghana. Madagascar has had community transmission of clade Ib since December 2025, beginning with a case without recent travel history, and it has spread rapidly nationwide. Outside Africa, France, Italy and Spain continue to report community transmission of clade Ib; Czechia has one case still under investigation. WHO published Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus, which compiles existing evidence and expert opinion on key considerations for MPXV genomic surveillance, to support the use of pathogen genomics in public health surveillance and response (WHO, 22 January).

1ooaRYegMy_og5ozuZ4enw.zh: 泊爾今年疫情上升,已報告35例死亡,自6月以來新增175例病例,病例及死亡數均明顯高於去年,以藍毗省報告55例病例及11例死亡為多,70%病例為15歲以上族群,當局規劃啟動疫苗接種措施。
1ooaRYegMy_og5ozuZ4enw.en: Nepal's situation is rising this year. 35 deaths have been reported, and 175 new cases have been added since June; both cases and deaths are clearly higher than last year. Lumbini province reported the most, with 55 cases and 11 deaths. 70% of cases are in people aged 15 and over. Authorities plan to launch vaccination measures.

4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.zh: WHO於12/10報告今(2025)年截至11/30,全球季節性流感自10月起活動度上升,目前全球流行以 A(H3N2) 為主,另自8月起,多國之K分支檢出率上升,北半球部分國家的流感季較往年提早,南半球部分國家的流感季節較往年延長。西太平洋區自10 月起活動度增加,日本及韓國提早進入流感季,紐西蘭及斐濟活動度處高峰或上升, GISAID資料顯示截至11/21,西太平洋區之病毒序列有89%為K分支;東南亞地區自6月上升,8月達高峰後趨緩,惟部分國家活動度仍偏高,另GISAID資料顯示泊爾、印度、泰國已檢出K分支;北美洲地區活動度上升,美國及加拿大K分支檢出率增加;歐洲地區部份國家第45-46 週陽性率超過10%,流感季較往年提前約4週開始,其中西歐較早上升,65 歲以上住院比例增加;WHO 評估全球流感活動度上升仍在預期範圍,流感病毒與其他呼吸道病毒共同流行,可能對醫療系統造成壓力,多國已檢出A(H3N2) K分支,目前證據未顯示K分支有致疾病嚴重度提升之情形,疫苗仍預期能降低重症風險。
4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.en: WHO reported on 10 December that, as of 30 November this year, global seasonal influenza activity has risen since October, with A(H3N2) currently predominant worldwide. Since August, detection of subclade K has increased in several countries. Some northern hemisphere countries' flu seasons began earlier than usual, and some southern hemisphere countries' seasons were longer than usual. In the Western Pacific Region, activity has increased since October, with Japan and South Korea entering the flu season early; New Zealand and Fiji are at or rising towards peak activity. GISAID data show that as of 21 November, 89% of virus sequences in the Western Pacific Region belonged to subclade K. In Southeast Asia, activity rose from June, peaked in August and then eased, although activity remains high in some countries; GISAID data show subclade K has been detected in Nepal, India and Thailand. In North America, activity has risen, with increased subclade K detection in the United States and Canada. In some European countries, test positivity exceeded 10% in weeks 45–46; the flu season began about four weeks earlier than usual, with Western Europe rising first, and hospitalisation among people aged 65 and over has increased. WHO assesses that the rise in global influenza activity is within the expected range. Influenza viruses are circulating alongside other respiratory viruses, which may put pressure on health systems. Several countries have detected A(H3N2) subclade K. Current evidence does not show that subclade K causes more severe disease, and vaccines are still expected to reduce the risk of severe illness.

9-FscTc0Ky68AacCKLm3tg.zh: 泊爾疫情上升,今年迄今累計報告164例確診病例及31例死亡,病例數高於去年全年病例數86例,且死亡數為近10年來最多,死亡病例主要為40歲以上且未接種疫苗者。
9-FscTc0Ky68AacCKLm3tg.en: Nepal's outbreak is rising. So far this year, 164 confirmed cases and 31 deaths have been reported cumulatively. The case count exceeds last year's full-year total by 86 cases, and the number of deaths is the highest in 10 years. Most deaths occurred among people aged over 40 who had not been vaccinated.

merfEYWK1Nnvtdpj6TuRLg.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第42週(10/13-19)全球陽性率10.88%,其中,歐洲及東地中海區署陽性率增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第43週定醫平均報告數2.25,已連續6週下降,分布以東京都、神奈川縣為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情呈下降趨勢,第42週陽性率12.19%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 東南亞疫情處低點,孟加拉、印度、泰國及泊爾等國第42週陽性率皆處低點。 澳洲疫情處低點,第41週定點實驗室監測陽性率降至1.2%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(52.3%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈波動下降趨勢,其中,東南亞、歐洲及東地中海區呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(占81%),其次為NB.1.8.1(占12%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
merfEYWK1Nnvtdpj6TuRLg.en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 42 of 2025 (13–19 October) was 10.88%, and the European and Eastern Mediterranean regional offices saw increases in positivity. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 43, the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 2.25, having declined for six consecutive weeks. Cases are concentrated in Tokyo and Kanagawa prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. South Korea: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 42 was 12.19%, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Southeast Asia: The outbreak is at a low point; positivity rates in week 42 were at low levels in Bangladesh, India, Thailand and Nepal. Australia: The outbreak is at a low point. The positivity rate in sentinel laboratory surveillance fell to 1.2% in week 41, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share (52.3%). Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown a fluctuating downward trend, but Southeast Asia, Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean regions are rising. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG (81%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (12%). WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

BpNIsfiQD-LUhmE-vRnI2Q.zh: 泊爾疫情上升,今年迄今累計報告133例病例及31例死亡,其中74%為40歲以上無接種疫苗之農業工作者,病患主要集中於稻田或養豬/雞場周圍,病例及死亡人數皆為近3年最高,當局表示該國現有疫苗短缺問題;該國於2022-24年分別累計報告79/105/86例病例。
BpNIsfiQD-LUhmE-vRnI2Q.en: Nepal's outbreak is rising. So far this year, 133 cases and 31 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Of the cases, 74% were unvaccinated agricultural workers aged over 40, and cases are mainly concentrated around rice paddies or pig and poultry farms. Both case and death numbers are the highest in the past three years. Authorities say the country currently faces a vaccine shortage. Nepal reported 79, 105 and 86 cases cumulatively in 2022, 2023 and 2024 respectively.

vDk0C0JCtydO9nLmm-iMnA.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第36週(9/1-7)全球陽性率18.98%,除非洲及東地中海以外,各區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情於低點,第38週(9/15-21)門急診陽性率5.3%,較前一週下降,住院陽性率呈下降趨勢,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 香港疫情於低點,第38週陽性率下降至0.65%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 東南亞疫情處低點,第38週報告病例數及死亡數均低,其中,印度及泊爾變異株以XFG占比最高,泰國以NB.1.8.1為主。 美國疫情呈下降趨勢,第37週陽性率9.5%,已連續3週下降,住院率亦呈下降趨勢,惟死亡率仍處高點。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,除非洲及東地中海以外,各區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(72%),其次為NB.1.8.1(19%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
vDk0C0JCtydO9nLmm-iMnA.en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 36 of 2025 (1–7 September) was 18.98%, with positivity increasing in all regional offices except Africa and the Eastern Mediterranean. China: The outbreak is at a low point. The outpatient and emergency positivity rate in week 38 (15–21 September) was 5.3%, lower than the previous week, and the hospital positivity rate is also declining. The variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Hong Kong: The outbreak is at a low point. The positivity rate fell to 0.65% in week 38, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Southeast Asia: The outbreak is at a low point. In week 38, reported cases and deaths were low; the variant XFG has the highest share in India and Nepal, and NB.1.8.1 predominates in Thailand. United States: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 37 was 9.5%, having declined for three consecutive weeks; hospitalization rates are also declining, but the mortality rate remains high. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown an upward trend, with increases in all regional offices except Africa and the Eastern Mediterranean. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG (72%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (19%). WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

ZMr3St0cpOPJo_Q6xifkjw.zh: 泊爾疫情上升,迄今累計36地區報告113例病例及23例死亡,病例主要分布於藍毗、馬德什及科什等省。多數病例為40歲以上且未接種疫苗者,適逢雨季增加病媒蚊孳生及疾病傳播風險,近年疾病由特萊平原傳播至丘陵區。
ZMr3St0cpOPJo_Q6xifkjw.en: Nepal's outbreak is rising: to date, 113 cases and 23 deaths have been cumulatively reported across 36 areas. Cases are mainly distributed in Lumbini, Madhesh and Koshi provinces. Most cases are people over 40 years old who were unvaccinated. The rainy season increases mosquito breeding and the risk of disease transmission, and in recent years the disease has spread from the Terai plains to hilly areas.

TuopZnVSDEL7JrjcIDjK1w.zh: 泊爾南部比爾根杰市(Birgunj)爆發疫情,8/24報告42例病例,逾130例疑病例(腹瀉),其中2例腹瀉病患死亡;當局禁止流動攤販營業,學校停課2天,並檢測飲用水,以釐清感染源。
TuopZnVSDEL7JrjcIDjK1w.en: An outbreak has occurred in Birgunj City in southern Nepal. As of 24 August, 42 cases were reported, along with more than 130 suspected cases (diarrhoea), of which two diarrhoea patients died. Authorities have banned mobile street vendors from operating, closed schools for two days, and tested drinking water to clarify the source of infection.

Ggnqk6lGXHmZkWxtyl3WSA.zh: 泊爾甘達基省近3週新增202例病例,自前1個月迄今累計811例病例,其中,以博卡拉市報告432例病例為多,該市去年累計逾8,600例確診及3例死亡。當局預估未來幾週疫情將持續上升,已加強防治措施,避免疫情蔓延。
Ggnqk6lGXHmZkWxtyl3WSA.en: Gandaki Province in Nepal has added 202 cases in the past three weeks, and has recorded 811 cases cumulatively since one month earlier. Pokhara City has reported the most, with 432 cases. Last year, the city cumulatively recorded more than 8,600 confirmed cases and three deaths. Authorities expect cases to continue rising over the coming weeks and have strengthened prevention and control measures to prevent the spread.

5tYBIlBnEzv57WhZH02JgQ.zh: 泊爾達丁縣偏遠村莊報告3例死亡病例,病患在1個半月內相繼死亡,皆無被犬隻或其他動物咬傷紀錄,當局已針對近300位鄰近居民進行暴露後預防接種作業。該國每年報告10-100例病例,惟民眾通報意識不足,病例數有低估情形。
5tYBIlBnEzv57WhZH02JgQ.en: In a remote village in Dhading District, Nepal, three deaths were reported; the patients died one after another within one and a half months, and none had a record of being bitten by dogs or other animals. Authorities have carried out post-exposure vaccination for nearly 300 neighbouring residents. The country reports 10–100 cases per year, but public awareness of reporting is insufficient, and case numbers are likely underestimated.

INK9QIjivlSTTc5aJxESkg.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年6月截至今年7/25累計139國/地區報告15萬4千餘例確診病例,其中至少385例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第30週累計79國/地區報告3萬3,370例確診病例,其中非洲區2萬8,481例、美洲區2,343例、歐洲區1,706例、西太平洋區755例、東南亞區52例及東地中海區33例。  其他更新:  中國今年截至7/31報告23例Ib型確診病例,其中7例具疫區旅遊史,包含烏干達(2例)、坦尚亞(2例)、剛果民主共和國(2例)、西非國家(剛果、馬利),另2例具泊爾及1例具阿拉伯聯合大公國旅遊史,其餘個案為本土傳播,其中,包含居住在中國之非洲僑民。WHO基於所有通報群聚事件中,指標個案均能與旅遊史有流行病學關聯,故將該國傳播分類由「未知傳播鏈」更正為「與旅遊相關個案」,惟仍無法排除尚未偵測到之社區傳播可能性。當局已在疫區進行廢水監測,並加強衛教及提供無症狀者藥物。 澳大利亞7/19報告新增2例Ib型病例,案1近期有烏干達旅遊史,案2為案1家庭接觸者,當局已加強監測疫情。 英國7/22新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性,具肯亞旅遊史,當局已展開疫調與監測,並提供接觸者疫苗。  評估與建議: WHO於2025年6月5日召開國際衛生條例(IHR)緊急委員會第四次會議,討論2024年M痘疫情上升的情形。會議確認該事件仍構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並針對受影響國家提出各項臨時建議,包括加強監測、提升診斷能力、推動疫苗接種、改善臨床護理、強化跨境合作,以及加強社區參與和資金支持,並將現行建議延長至2025年8月20日。
INK9QIjivlSTTc5aJxESkg.en: Monthly update: since June 2022 and as of 25 July this year, 139 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 154,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 385 died (CFR: 0.2%). This year, as of week 30, 79 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 33,370 confirmed cases: African Region 28,481; Region of the Americas 2,343; European Region 1,706; Western Pacific Region 755; South-East Asia Region 52; and Eastern Mediterranean Region 33. Other updates: China reported 23 confirmed clade Ib cases as of 31 July this year, of which seven had travel history to affected areas, including Uganda (2), Tanzania (2), the DRC (2), and West African countries (Congo, Mali); two had travel history to Nepal and one to the UAE. The other cases were locally transmitted, including African nationals living in China. Based on all reported clusters in which the index cases had epidemiological links to travel, WHO has reclassified China's transmission category from 'unknown transmission chain' to 'travel-associated cases', although undetected community transmission cannot be ruled out. Authorities have launched wastewater surveillance in affected areas, strengthened health education, and provided medicines to asymptomatic people. Australia reported two new clade Ib cases on 19 July: case 1 had recent travel history to Uganda, and case 2 was a household contact of case 1; authorities have strengthened surveillance. The UK reported one new clade Ib case on 22 July, an adult male with travel history to Kenya; authorities have launched epidemiological investigation and surveillance and provided vaccines to contacts. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the fourth meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on 5 June 2025 to discuss the rise in mpox since 2024. The meeting confirmed that the event still constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), and issued temporary recommendations for affected countries, including strengthening surveillance, improving diagnostic capacity, promoting vaccination, improving clinical care, strengthening cross-border cooperation, and enhancing community engagement and financial support. Current recommendations were extended to 20 August 2025.

Indonesia update: As of 19 October this year, more than 203,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 1,210 deaths.

Sri Lanka update: So far this year, more than 42,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 20 deaths.

Nepal update: As of 25 October this year, more than 27,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 11 deaths; this is lower than the same period last year.

oWLHRkPFHLU6ARFQNPSTGw.en: Japanese encephalitis is rising in Nepal. So far this year, 80 cases have been cumulatively reported from 30 districts, including 23 deaths, a case fatality rate above 28%. Deaths this year already exceed the 7 reported last year. Most cases are among children under 15 years old.

unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.zh: 全球疫情更新,今年迄今累計超過1,300萬例病例及8,500例死亡:  美洲區病例數以巴西為多,其次為阿根廷、墨西哥、巴拉圭、哥倫比亞; 歐洲區法國、義大利、西班牙有報告病例; 東地中海區伊朗、阿富汗、巴基斯坦有報告病例; 東南亞區孟加拉及泊爾病例數上升,印度喀拉拉邦及卡納塔卡邦今年病例數高於去年同期,印病例數下降; 西太平洋區中國及越南病例數上升,柬埔寨病例數下降; 非洲區中非共和國於9月中公布爆發疫情,多哥疫情亦上升。
unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.en:
Global update: So far this year, more than 13 million cases and 8,500 deaths have been cumulatively reported globally.

Americas: Case numbers are highest in Brazil, followed by Argentina, Mexico, Paraguay and Colombia.

Europe: France, Italy and Spain have reported cases.

Eastern Mediterranean: Iran, Afghanistan and Pakistan have reported cases.

South-East Asia: Case numbers rose in Bangladesh and Nepal. In the Indian states of Kerala and Karnataka, cases this year are higher than in the same period last year. Case numbers in Indonesia declined.

Western Pacific: Case numbers rose in China and Viet Nam and fell in Cambodia.

Africa: The Central African Republic announced an outbreak in mid-September, and cases in Togo also rose.
